title: If you're looking for a deal, look elsewhere
text:
This is a tiny amount of coffee for $24; something like half a pound for four different flavors. It's not remotely a value, and if that's bothersome, move on to something else.

However, what you do get is the opportunity to try four possibly delicious varieties, but certainly high quality, different flavors of coffee every month. On more than one occasion I've spent $20 or more on a pound of coffee I didn't want to finish. This gives me the chance to spend $6 a flavor and explore coffees I would never have tried any other way.

One thing I want to emphasize is each of the four samples I got were incredibly fresh, and very high quality. I'm typically incredibly picky with my beans, and each of the four had something about them that I liked.

I'm going to keep my subscription going for as long as the variety adds $24 a month of value to my life. Maybe I'll find a new favorite bean, and that might be worth it on its own.
label: positive
